reasons: Lake identity is verified for Almeida-Sanchez v. United States.
Lake citation fields match 413 U.S. 266, 93 S. Ct. 2535, 37 L. Ed. 2d 596, and 1973 U.S. LEXIS 44.
Lake identity lists U.S. Supreme Court, decided 1973-06-21, year 1973.
The opinion directly distinguishes routine border searches and functional equivalents from interior roving-patrol searches.
The opinion states that functional-equivalent border searches may occur at established stations near the border or nonstop international-flight airports.
The case supplies a core Supreme Court limit within the border-search doctrine, supporting Key - Anchor treatment for Border Searches.
The opinion says petitioner's sole contention was that the marihuana should not have been admitted under Weeks because the automobile search was unconstitutional.
The judgment was reversed after the Court held the search violated the Fourth Amendment.
That supports a Related cross-doctrine role for The Exclusionary Rule.
